_comment: Per-file line cap for hand-written code modules, enforced by the harness (PreToolUse block) and `interlinked verify` (large_files check). Files listed below exceeded the cap when enforcement was enabled (2026-05-18) and are grandfathered at their recorded line count: a listed file may shrink or hold, but the harness blocks any edit that grows it and verify fails it. Drop a file below max_lines (decompose it) to delete its entry. Generated, test, and .d.ts files are exempt from the cap and never appear here. Ratchet `max_lines` downward (1500 -> 1200 -> 1000) as this list empties. Policy: src/harness/large-file-policy.ts.
